task: Convert beamSystem hit-detection from a full-[Health,Position] scan to a spatial-hash queryRadius broad-phase (identical-by-construction), reusing the collisionSystem grid; handle grid staleness (knockbackSystem moves entities before beam) via a realized-displacement world bound; folded into PR #678 with the earlier melee half as one combined combat-perf change
notes: Combined melee+beam branch. Melee half (shipped first) was 3 apples. Path A folded the beam conversion + knockback coupling + the full >3-apple harness into the same PR #678, landing the combined branch at 4 apples. The beam adds one hazard melee lacks: the grid is STALE for beam because knockbackSystem runs between grid build and beamSystem and translates positions, so the beam superset radius R = halfLen + BEAM_HIT_HALF_WIDTH + maxKnockbackStepThisFrame + EPS must absorb one realized (post-clamp) knockback step. Introduced world.maxKnockbackStepThisFrame as an authoritative writer-agnostic bound measured via Math.hypot on the final clamped displacement. Identical-by-construction preserved: superset grid.queryRadius broad-phase + byte-identical legacy narrow-phase + once-per-frame canonical rank map reproducing bitecs dense-array order, with an executable full-scan fallback for sprite-less-Health worlds. Determinism proven by two NEW permanent seeded tests (multi-frame lockstep differential incl. a knockback-witness case + full-pipeline headless guard) anchored to a clean main baseline. Harness: dual_plan_synthesis (gpt-5.4 + gemini-3.1-pro-preview planners, claude-opus-4.8 judge), plan_review (gpt-5.5, 7 concerns resolved), multi_model_review (gpt-5.3-codex + gemini-3.1-pro-preview + gpt-5.5, all clean, claude-opus-4.8 adjudicated 0 valid concerns), code_review loop (claude-sonnet-4.6 round 3 caught a MAJOR vacuous-invariant-guard defect the multi-model round missed - stores.sprite.width[eid] on a Float32Array never returns undefined - fixed with a real hasComponent(target,Sprite) assertion and re-verified). Bench: beam grid ~2.4x-4.7x faster at Floor-2 spread scale, parity on idle tick-gated frames (lazy rank-map build), ~1.9x slower only in the pathological all-clustered-in-range dense case that ADR 0024's <=6 active-enemy engagement budget prevents in real play. Engagement budget validated at scale, no gameplay change.
